0.original: Estinien is ready to escort Mehrahd to safety.

24.original: Speak with Ojika Tsunjika at the Baldesion Annex.

48.original: Estinien is... I think he is not as gruff as he makes out to be.

49.original: I shall leave you to recruit G'raha. He'll appreciate the invitation that much more, I'm sure.

50.original: As I recall, he was based at the annex. Someone there ought to be able to point you in the right direction.

51.original: Let us be off too, Mehrahd. Do me a favor and don't stray from the path.

52.original: Oh, look who it is! Welcome back, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

53.original: What might the Students do for you?

54.original: G'raha? Yes, he's in the main hall with Mistress Krile.

55.original: They've been holed up in there for <hex:021A020203>days<hex:021A020103>. By all means, go and give them an excuse to take a break!

56.original: Well, she wasn't hard to find, at least...

58.original: I've visited Labyrinthos on several occasions recently, but I've not set foot in Thaumazein since the day we boarded the <hex:021A020203>Ragnarok<hex:021A020103>...

59.original: I don't see Thancred anywhere. Was he not supposed to be traveling with Urianger?

60.original: Ah, the thrill of imminent adventure! I never tire of this feeling.

62.original: In my travels, I spied many a child wandering alone─orphans, in all likelihood. Though homes razed by beasts and blasphemies can be rebuilt, the void left by those we have lost cannot so easily be filled...

63.original: I will pray to Sanduruva for your safe return. May the wealth of Her blessings guide you to the treasure you seek...

64.original: I send you to recruit G'raha and you return with an entire survey party.

65.original: I hope Matsya's boat is sturdy enough to carry us all...

66.original: What he means is, we are grateful for the use of one of your precious fishing vessels.

67.original: We are more than glad for the chance to provide it. I ask only that you take care to steer clear of the reefs in the shallows there.

68.original: Aye, we will keep an eye out.
